title: Non-polynomial growth for k-dominating independent sets in incidence graphs of projective planes
statement:
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be the family of incidence graphs of projective planes, and let $\text{mi}_k(n,\mathcal{F})$ denote the maximum number of $k$-dominating independent sets among $n$-vertex graphs in this family.

**Projective-plane incidence-graph conjecture.** The function $\text{mi}_k(n,\mathcal{F})$ is not bounded above by any polynomial in $n$.

This addresses the growth-rate alternatives posed for structured graph families and predicts superpolynomially many $k$-dominating independent sets in incidence graphs of projective planes. The source gives no resolution.
source_name: Zoltán Lóránt Nagy, “On the number of k-dominating independent sets”, arXiv:1504.03224 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.03224

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2015).
